_comment: S1c touch-up mixture (BACKLOG B-21, run parameters pinned 2026-10-13): the reasoning-shaped families (the one factor, W1.3/W1.4 - temporal_numeric, multi_hop, policy_trap, tradeoff with drawn arity and permuted option order) with a 25% seeded replay of everything the arm has seen. Build the reasoning part with: uv run python -m training.build_jev_families --families temporal_numeric,multi_hop,policy_trap,tradeoff --out data/train_jev_reasoning_s1c.jsonl --public-dir /path/to/jevbench/datasets/public
